title: A day in the life of Josh

copy.heading: A day in the life of Josh
body: The following timeline was recorded over one ordinary Tuesday, with Lauren's help and Josh's full cooperation, until he found out what it was for.
5.50am. The group chat wakes up. Somebody has a court at 7am and is one short. Josh reads all forty-one messages in bed.
6.10am. Alfie wakes up. Josh says, "Can you get him? I'm just sorting something." He is sorting Thursday.
7.30am. Breakfast. Mia asks why the sky is blue. Josh says it is to do with light, "a bit like the way the ball comes off the back glass", and demonstrates with a satsuma.
8.15am. Nursery drop-off. Josh tells another dad that padel is the fastest-growing sport in the world. The other dad had asked where to park.
9.30am. Monday stand-up, held on a Tuesday because of a bank holiday. Josh opens with a quick padel stat.
1pm. Lunch with a client. Josh is wearing a quarter-zip.
6.30pm. Bath time. Josh is in the car park at the club, "just grabbing a hit".
9.45pm. Josh gets home and asks how bath time went. Then he tells Lauren how his hit went, with the graphs.
